segments.text: Fir juban hilane ki aukaat diya hai bhagwan ne?
Mera aukaat hai, isiliye koi tere peso se main bakchodi kar rahi hu.
Hota na to ispe jhaat nahi ukhadte.
Mera aukaat nahi hai isiliye video calling pe baat karne ki aukaat nahi hai faltu ki tu baat kar raha hai.
Agar hota na to ispe jhaat nahi ukhadte.
Tu to faltu ki baate to kahe kar raha hai?
Agar bol nahi sakta maximum juban to achi kar.
Sun upar wala na sabhi ka karam dekh raha hai.
Bekar me kisi ladkiyo ko aake dis-motivate karne ki aukaat mat dikha.
Upar wala apna aukaat dikha dega na tu ghar ka rahega na ghat ka rahega.
Wahi keh rahe hai jab agar hoti na to ispe jhaat nahi ukhadte.
Meri aukaat kya hai upar wala decide karega tu karne wala nahi hai.
Teri aukaat cancer hai, juban me cancer hoga isiliye tu aisa ganda word use karta hai ladkiyo ke sath.
Are to sahi Ladkiyo ke sath fir sath gandi word use karega Bajrang Bali aur Shani Dev ki kaali drishti aise hi teri zindagi jhandwa kar degi.
Teri jo itni juban chala raha hai na ghamandwa karke teri ghamandwa chur chur kar degi.
Haa teri maa ke gaand me bhi tu dal sakta hai.
Wahi keh raha hai gaand me dal Lena.
Poket me ho jayega, ha mai janti hu teri aukaat nahi hai to apni maa ke gaand me hi dala kar.
Wahi to bol rahe hai gaand me dal Lena apna.
Haa teri maa ke dal le na.
Tujhe teri maa ki chinal hai kya?
Tu janti hu chinal ka beta hai tu, tera aukaat nahi hai.
Tu idhar bhadwagiri karne kahe ko aaya?
Aur nahi ghus paye to batao hum ghusaenge do teen din ke sath.
Haa to mai janti hu tujhko ladkiya thookti bhi nahi hai.
